declarations.name: Acl
declarations.doc: Access control list. Like Phalcon's ACL, a role can inherit others (inherits: `admin` inherits `editor`) and receive permissions (permissions: `editor` → `invoices.edit`); the session's roles and permissions come from `SessionManager.start`.

members.name: screens
members.doc: The rule of each screen (the generated router registers them).

members.name: can
members.doc: The session has one of roles (or a role that inherits it), all permissions, and every guard allows it. Without a session only an open rule passes.

members.name: check
members.doc: The same as can, waiting for the guards whose `canActivate` is async.

members.name: canOpenAsync
members.doc: canOpen for the router and AclBuilder: async when a guard of the rule is.

members.name: canOpen
members.doc: Whether the session can open screen (a type with a rule in screens); the answers for roles and permissions are kept until the session changes. Use it to hide buttons to screens it cannot open.

declarations.name: AclBuilder
declarations.doc: Shows child when the session passes the rule (roles, permissions, guards; or the rule of screen), otherwise fallback. It changes with the session while its screen is visible.

declarations.name: AclRule
declarations.doc: What a screen or a use case asks of the session: one of roles (when given), all of permissions, and every guard (types of Guard registered in the injector).

declarations.name: AppConfig
declarations.doc: The project configuration (`appConfig` kind): connections and global services.

members.name: local
members.doc: How the local database is kept (encryption); in a component's config, for the tables of its models.

declarations.name: AppEvent
declarations.doc: Base of the global events (`event` kind). An event is a typed message: whoever publishes it does not know who listens.

members.name: eventName
members.doc: The name and toJson of the event travel instead of the object when it is published from another Flutter engine (a workmanager task), where only JSON can be sent. The `event` kind writes both; an event without a name only travels from isolates of the same engine.

declarations.name: AppRoute
declarations.doc: A screen of the app (`@screen` of the dialect): where it is, how it is built from a URL, and who can open it.

members.name: path
members.doc: `/characters/:id`; null for a screen that is only the notFound page.

members.name: build
members.doc: Builds the screen from a URL: `(state) => CharacterScreen(id: state.arg('id'))`. A screen opened with `context.goTo(CharacterScreen(id: 1))` is that same object.

members.name: args
members.doc: The screen's parameters, for its URL: the ones named in path go there, the others to the query.

members.name: loggedIn
members.doc: Without an active session, the router goes to this screen.

members.name: acl
members.doc: What the session needs to open this screen; when it does not pass, the router goes to denied (or to loggedIn when there is no session).

members.name: shell
members.doc: A screen with a shell (tabs, a bottom bar) is the branch tab of shell; shellBuilder builds the shell around the navigator of its branches.

members.name: notFound
members.doc: The page of a location that no route has.

members.name: transition
members.doc: How the screen comes in; null is the platform's (Material / Cupertino).

members.name: location
members.doc: The URL that opens screen.

declarations.name: Cache
declarations.doc: How a repository method caches its responses (`@get(cache = true, cacheKey = "x", ttl = ...)`).

members.name: key
members.doc: Prefix of the entries; by default `Repository.method`. Every set of arguments is its own entry.

declarations.name: ComponentConfig
declarations.doc: The configuration of one component (`config` kind): its own connections and services.

members.name: logColor
members.doc: The color of the component's logs; without it, one is chosen by the component's name.

declarations.name: Connection
declarations.doc: A named connection of the project config: Http or WebSocket.

members.name: name
members.doc: `connectionName`; `''` is the default connection.

declarations.name: Decode
declarations.doc: Decoders the transpiler passes to Repository.send.

members.name: one
members.doc: `Character.fromJson` for one object.

members.name: list
members.doc: `Character.fromJson` for a list.

members.name: value
members.doc: A value as it comes (int, String, a map...).

members.name: values
members.doc: A list of values.

members.name: none
members.doc: No body (`void`).

declarations.name: DialogSize
declarations.doc: The width of a dialog.

declarations.name: DictionaryStore
declarations.doc: Downloaded dictionaries in `<app support>/dragonfly/i18n/<version>/<locale>/<file>.json`; the active version is in `current` (written last, so a download cut in half is never used).

members.name: prune
members.doc: Removes every version folder except keep.

declarations.name: DioInterceptorAdapter
declarations.doc: Adapts an HttpInterceptor to dio.

declarations.name: Dragonfly
declarations.doc: Entry point of the runtime: the injector, the connections and the response cache.

members.name: started
members.doc: start ran in this isolate (false in background isolates).

members.name: connections
members.doc: Every connection of the project config and the components' configs.

members.name: start
members.doc: Registers the project config, its connections and its global services, and starts them.

members.name: addConfig
members.doc: Adds the connections and services of a component's config, and the color of its logs.

members.name: connection
members.doc: The connection named name (`''` = the connection without `connectionName`).

members.name: reset
members.doc: Stops the global services and empties the injector, the connections, the cache and the local database (tests).

declarations.name: DragonflyDialog
declarations.doc: A dialog in three parts, like a Bootstrap modal: the header (the icon of its type, header and a close button), the body (child) and the footer.

members.name: color
members.doc: Replace the color and the icon of type for this dialog only.

members.name: show
members.doc: Opens the dialog; true when the user pressed Accept.

declarations.name: DragonflyForm
declarations.doc: A form bound to its manager: the fields inside (FormTextField, FormCheckbox, FormInput) are found by the name of the form model's field, and FormSubmit validates and calls onSubmit with the valid form model.

members.name: submit
members.doc: Validates and, when valid, calls onSubmit.

members.name: of
members.doc: The nearest form.

declarations.name: DragonflyNavigation
declarations.doc: Navigation by screen, not by URL. Only views navigate: they are the ones with a context.

members.name: goTo
members.doc: Shows screen instead of the current stack (its URL comes from its route).

members.name: pushTo
members.doc: Shows screen on top of the current one; the result is what the screen returns with goBack.

members.name: goBack
members.doc: Closes the current screen, returning result to pushTo.

members.name: requests
members.doc: Requests sent since the last start.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Empties the injector, the connections and the cache.

members.name: start
members.doc: Starts the app as `startDragonfly()` does, without network or devices: every `Http` connection of config answers with respondWith / respond (404 until then) and records requests; the session and the local database live in memory; `NetworkManager` reports network.

members.name: respondWith
members.doc: Every request answers json with status.

members.name: respond
members.doc: Each request answers what responder returns.

members.name: replace
members.doc: Registers fake as the T every class receives (a mock, a repository without network).

members.name: startSession
members.doc: Starts a session with data (for screens and use cases that need one).

members.name: pumpScreen
members.doc: Shows screen inside a MaterialApp and waits until it is still. Network images do not load in widget tests: their errors are ignored.

members.name: closeScreen
members.doc: Closes the shown screen and lets the timers it left run (a splash's minimum time and `onLoad`), so none is pending when the test ends. shortcut: waits one minute of test time; a longer timer still fails.

members.name: pumpRouter
members.doc: Shows the app with router (`buildRouter()` of the generated code) and waits.

members.name: tapText
members.doc: Taps the widget with text and waits.

members.name: enterTextIn
members.doc: Writes text in the text field that shows label (its label or hint).

declarations.name: DragonflyTranslate
declarations.doc: `'characters.home.title'.tr()` and `'cart.items'.tr({'n': 3})`.

declarations.name: EventBuilder
declarations.doc: Rebuilds with the last event of type T (null until one is published) while its screen is visible.

declarations.name: EventInterceptor
declarations.doc: Lets the backend publish global events: a response (or an error response) with the header header publishes the event its value names in events (`x-app-event: force_logout` → `events'force_logout'`). Unknown names are ignored.

declarations.name: EventListener
declarations.doc: Runs onEvent for each event of type T while its screen is visible (navigate, show a popup...).

declarations.name: Events
declarations.doc: The global event manager (publish / subscribe), like Guava's EventBus or Node's EventEmitter.

members.name: decoder
members.doc: How the event name is read back from its JSON (`registerModels` of `dragonfly.g.dart` calls it).

members.name: subscribe
members.doc: Calls handler with each event of type T published from now on. With active, only while it returns true (see Subscription.resume).

members.name: last
members.doc: The last event of type T published, if any.

members.name: init
members.doc: Receives the events that background isolates of the app publish (called by Dragonfly.start).

declarations.name: EventsOnDemand
declarations.doc: Event subscriptions that follow the screen of a State: onEvent handlers run while the screen is the visible route; the last event that arrived while it was hidden runs when it is visible again. The subscriptions end with the widget.

declarations.name: FieldCheck
declarations.doc: A remote check of one field: the error message, or null when value is valid.

declarations.name: ForceUpdate
declarations.doc: The backend asked for a newer version of the app.

declarations.name: FormCheckbox
declarations.doc: A checkbox for the boolean field name (with `@required`: it must be checked).

declarations.name: FormInput
declarations.doc: Any widget for the field name (a dropdown, a date picker...): builder receives the value, the error to show and the function that changes the value.

params.name: builder
params.type: (context: BuildContext, value: T?, error: string?, change: (value: T?) => void) => Widget

members.name: builder
members.type: (context: BuildContext, value: T?, error: string?, change: (value: T?) => void) => Widget

declarations.name: FormManager
declarations.doc: The state of one form: validates each field against the rules of its form model on every change, and runs the remote checks (checkOf, the `@validate` methods of the `formmanager` kind) after the rules pass, debounce after the last keystroke.

members.name: rules
members.doc: The rules of each field, in the order they are checked; every field of the form model is a key.

members.name: form
members.doc: The form model with the current values (valid only after submit accepted them).

members.name: checkOf
members.doc: The remote check of field (the `@validate` method of the `formmanager` kind, an API call through the component), or null when the field has none. It returns the error message (a translation key or the text) or null.

members.name: change
members.doc: The user changed field.

members.name: touch
members.doc: The user left field: its error shows from now on.

members.name: submit
members.doc: Validates every field (the remote checks too, without waiting for the debounce) and, when all pass, gives the form model to onValid. True when onValid ran without errors.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Back to the initial values, without errors shown.

declarations.name: FormSubmit
declarations.doc: The submit button: validates the form, calls `onSubmit` of the DragonflyForm when it is valid and shows a spinner meanwhile.

declarations.name: FormTextField
declarations.doc: The text field of the form model's field name. Number fields keep the text and the form model receives the number.

members.name: textInputAction
members.doc: TextInputAction.done submits the form.

declarations.name: FormValues
declarations.doc: The state of a form: the value and the error of each field.

members.name: errors
members.doc: Every field that is invalid now (shown with errorOf).

members.name: touched
members.doc: The fields the user left at least once.

members.name: checking
members.doc: The fields whose remote check is running.

members.name: attempted
members.doc: Submit was pressed at least once: from then on every error shows.

members.name: errorOf
members.doc: The error field shows: once the user left it or pressed submit.

declarations.name: Global
declarations.doc: A service that lives for the whole app (SessionManager, NetworkManager, Events...). It is listed in `globals` of the project config, registered in the injector and started by Dragonfly.start.

members.name: register
members.doc: Registers this object in the injector under its own type (`di.registerSingleton<Self>(this)`).

declarations.name: GlobalEvents
declarations.doc: Shows sessionStarted with the session data (T, what SessionManager.start received) while a session is active, and sessionEnded otherwise.

members.name: sessionEnded
members.doc: The event is null when no session ended yet (the app started without one).

declarations.name: Guard
declarations.doc: A custom access check (like NestJS's `CanActivate`): the `guard` kind writes one. It is registered in the injector, so it receives its dependencies (the session, a repository...).

members.name: canActivate
members.doc: `true` lets the session in. It can wait (`Future<bool>`: ask the server); then the router and AclBuilder wait for it, and the sync Acl.can / Guards.check cannot use it.

declarations.name: Guards
declarations.doc: Checks of the decorators of a use case (`@requires(internet = true, session = true)`, `@acl(roles = ..., permissions = ..., guards = ...)`). Returns the message of the first check that fails, or null.

members.name: verify
members.doc: check for an async use case: it waits for the guards whose `canActivate` is async.

declarations.name: Http
declarations.doc: An HTTP connection: a dio client with the options of the project config.

members.name: contentType
members.doc: Content type of the requests with a body. By default dio's: JSON for maps and lists. Never a default for every request: a GET with `Content-Type` makes the browser send a CORS preflight first (and dio warns).

members.name: dio
members.doc: The dio client, created the first time it is used. Tests can replace it.

declarations.name: HttpError
declarations.doc: A failed request.

members.name: headers
members.doc: Headers of the error response (lowercase names).

members.name: transient
members.doc: A temporary failure that another attempt may fix (timeouts, no connection, 5xx).

declarations.name: HttpInterceptor
declarations.doc: Runs before each request and after each response or error of an Http connection. Override only what you need; there are no handlers to call.

members.name: onRequest
members.doc: Change the request before it is sent (headers, query).

declarations.name: HttpLogInterceptor
declarations.doc: Logs each request and response with Log (nothing in release builds; tokens are masked).

declarations.name: Local
declarations.doc: The local database of the app: one table per model with a `@primary` (or `@generated`) field, the same tables, queries and CRUD as a backend repository, on the device (hive_ce: a file per table on Android, iOS, Linux, macOS and Windows, IndexedDB on web; encrypted as LocalData...

members.name: memory
members.doc: Tables live in memory and are not encrypted (tests): `DragonflyTest.start` sets it.

members.name: storage
members.doc: Where the encryption key is kept (`dragonfly.local.key`).

members.name: callsTable
members.doc: The table (box) that remembers which rows each http call answered.

members.name: tables
members.doc: Every registered table.

members.name: configure
members.doc: Takes the `local` of the project config (component `''`) or of a component's config.

members.name: settings
members.doc: How the tables of component are kept: its config's `local`, else the project's, else encrypted.

members.name: register
members.doc: Registers the table of T (of the models of component); a second registration of the same model replaces the first.

members.name: table
members.doc: The table of T; a model without `@primary` has none.

members.name: start
members.doc: Opens the database once: the folder of the app (not on web).

members.name: open
members.doc: The box named name, opened as the settings of component say (in memory and plain when memory).

members.name: store
members.doc: Saves what the http call call answered: the rows of value (a model or a list of models) go to their table and call remembers which they were.

members.name: recall
members.doc: The JSON the call call stored, read from its table (the rows as they are now): a map, or a list of maps. NotFound when the call never stored anything or its row was removed.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Closes the database and forgets the tables (tests; `Dragonfly.reset` calls it).

declarations.name: LocalDatabase
declarations.doc: How the local database is kept, set in the project config (`local` of `appConfig`) and, for the tables of one component's models, in its config (`local` of `config`).

members.name: encrypted
members.doc: AES-256 with a key generated once and kept in the device's secure storage (Keychain, Keystore, libsecret, DPAPI, WebCrypto).

declarations.name: LocalQuery
declarations.doc: One query of a table. where, orderBy, limit and offset add to it; the others run it.

members.name: where
members.doc: Equality (`{'done': true}`) or an operator (`{'age': gt(18)}`, `{'name': like('Ri%')}`).

members.name: count
members.doc: Rows that match the conditions (limit and offset do not count).

members.name: paginate
members.doc: One page (from 1) of size rows, with the total of rows and of pages.

members.name: update
members.doc: Sets values on every matching row; the number of rows changed.

members.name: delete
members.doc: Deletes every matching row; the number of rows deleted.

declarations.name: LocalTable
declarations.doc: One local table: the rows of model T by its `@primary` field, as JSON (`toJson`/`fromJson`). CRUD without writing it (find, findAll, save, remove) and a query builder (where, orderBy, limit, offset, then `getOne`, `getMany`, `count`, `exists`, `update`, `delete`).

members.name: name
members.doc: The box name: `dragonfly_` + the model's name in snake_case, or the name `@entity("...")` gives.

members.name: component
members.doc: The component the model belongs to: its config's `local` says how the table is kept.

members.name: key
members.doc: JSON name of the `@primary` / `@generated` field.

members.name: generated
members.doc: `@generated`: a row saved with a null key gets the next number.

members.name: created
members.doc: JSON names of the `@created` / `@updated` fields, stamped by the table.

members.name: keyOf
members.doc: The box key of a row: hive keys are `int` or `String`.

members.name: save
members.doc: Writes value (a new row or the one with its key) and returns it as saved (with its generated key and stamps).

members.name: remove
members.doc: Deletes the row id; false when there was none.

members.name: put
members.doc: Writes the JSON of value and returns the row written.

members.name: putRow
members.doc: Writes row: a null `@generated` key gets the next number; `@created` is set when the row has none, `@updated` always.

declarations.name: Log
declarations.doc: App logs, grouped and colored by component:

members.name: level
members.doc: The lowest level written; in release builds it is never below LogLevel.warn.

members.name: sink
members.doc: Receives every written entry (send them to a crash reporter, a file...).

members.name: console
members.doc: Writes to the console (false: only sink).

members.name: colors
members.doc: ANSI colors in the console; false gives plain text (files, terminals without colors).

members.name: componentColors
members.doc: Color of each component; one without a color gets one of LogColor by its name, always the same. The `logColor` of a component's config is written here.

members.name: dragonflyColor
members.doc: Color of the logs of Dragonfly itself (`dragonfly › http`...).

members.name: width
members.doc: Width of the frame's top and bottom lines.

members.name: appPackage
members.doc: The app's package: its frames lead the stack of an exception (`startDragonfly` sets it).

members.name: d
members.doc: Debug (blue): details for the developer while building, such as values, steps or requests. Not written in release builds.

members.name: i
members.doc: Info (cyan): something normal happened that is worth knowing, such as a screen opening or a session starting. Not written in release builds.

members.name: s
members.doc: Success (green): an operation finished well, such as data loaded or a form saved. Not written in release builds.

members.name: w
members.doc: Warning (yellow): something unexpected that the app survives, such as a slow response, a retry or a missing value with a default. Written in release builds.

members.name: e
members.doc: Error (red): something failed. Pass error and stackTrace to see the exception and the exact place where it happened (marked with ▶, the only line that blinks). Written in release builds.

members.name: debug
members.doc: Same as d.

members.name: info
members.doc: Same as i.

members.name: success
members.doc: Same as s.

members.name: warn
members.doc: Same as w.

members.name: error
members.doc: Same as e.

members.name: write
members.doc: Writes a log of level l; d, i, s, w and e call it. data is any value (shown as JSON, sensitive keys masked); at is the breadcrumb, written by Nuclear.

members.name: colorOf
members.doc: The color of component's breadcrumb.

members.name: format
members.doc: The text of entry as the console shows it. Bold, blink and color go in separate sequences: the debug console of VS Code reads `ESC[1;38;5;42m` as bold + blink (5) + background (42).

members.name: catchFlutterErrors
members.doc: Flutter's errors (build, layout, platform messages...) printed by formatError instead of Flutter's own format, and sent to sink.

members.name: presentError
members.doc: What FlutterError.presentError does with catchFlutterErrors: the whole report the first time, one line when the same error repeats (a layout overflow repeats on every frame).

members.name: formatError
members.doc: The text of a Flutter error: what failed, where, and the stack with the app's frames first in sight (Dart SDK frames hidden, Flutter's dimmed).

members.name: mask
members.doc: data with the values of sensitive keys replaced by `***`.

declarations.name: LogColor
declarations.doc: Vivid colors (xterm-256) for the component of each breadcrumb, readable on the dark background of the IDE consoles. Purple is reserved for Dragonfly's own logs (Log.dragonflyColor).

members.name: color
members.doc: xterm-256 color.

declarations.name: LogEntry
declarations.doc: One written log: what Log.sink receives.

members.name: data
members.doc: The data, with sensitive values already masked.

members.name: at
members.doc: Where the log was written: `characters › repository › CharacterRepository.getPage · <file>.nuc:12` (Nuclear writes it in every `Log` call).

members.name: crumbs
members.doc: The breadcrumb, without the location: `characters, repository, CharacterRepository.getPage`.

members.name: location
members.doc: The `.nuc` file and line, when known.

members.name: component
members.doc: The component: the first crumb.

declarations.name: LogLevel
declarations.doc: The levels, with the vivid colors of Bootstrap's alerts in dark mode for the title and the frame (primary, info, success, warning, danger) and a message color that contrasts with them.

members.name: color
members.doc: Color of the title and of the frame (xterm-256).

members.name: text
members.doc: Color of the message: near white, with a light tint in warnings and errors (xterm-256).

declarations.name: MemoryCache
declarations.doc: In-memory cache of decoded responses. Entries expire after their TTL; past maxEntries the expired ones are dropped, then the oldest.

members.name: read
members.doc: The cached value of key, or null when it is missing or expired.

members.name: purge
members.doc: Removes every entry whose key starts with prefix (all the pages of `Repo.getAll`).

declarations.name: NetworkBuilder
declarations.doc: Rebuilds when the network status changes.

declarations.name: NetworkManager
declarations.doc: Whether the device can reach the internet, the connection type and its quality. It probes only when the connectivity changes (debounced) or when check is called, to save battery and data.

constructors.name: fixed
constructors.doc: A manager that always reports status and never asks the system (tests, previews).

members.name: probeHost
members.doc: Host resolved to know that the internet (not only the local network) is reachable.

members.name: weakAfter
members.doc: A probe slower than this is a weak connection.

members.name: check
members.doc: Probes now and updates status.

members.name: latency

declarations.name: NetworkWrapper
declarations.doc: Wraps the whole app: shows offline (a banner by default) over it while there is no internet.

declarations.name: NotFound

declarations.name: Op
declarations.doc: A comparison of `where` other than equality.

declarations.doc: One page of a query (Nuclear's `Page<T>`, ADR-0100): items, page (from 1), size, total rows and pages. The same class reads a backend's paged answer (`PageOf.fromJson(json, Task.fromJson)`).

declarations.doc: How popups look. The colors come from the app's theme (info = primary, danger = error); any color, icon or width can be replaced: `Popups.theme = PopupTheme(colors: {PopupType.success: Colors.teal})`.

declarations.name: PopupType
declarations.doc: The kind of message, as in Bootstrap: each one has its color and its icon.

declarations.name: Popups
declarations.doc: Popups with one call: dialogs, toasts and snack bars, all with the PopupType colors and icons.

members.name: alert
members.doc: A message with a title and a Close button.

members.name: confirm
members.doc: true when the user accepts.

members.name: show
members.doc: A dialog with any content.

members.name: loading

members.name: toast
members.doc: A short message over the app that does not block it and goes away after duration. It needs no Scaffold.

members.name: snackbar
members.doc: A snack bar of the nearest Scaffold, with the color and icon of type and an optional action.

declarations.name: RemoteDictionaries

members.name: client
members.doc: The http client (null: a new one; tests give their own).

declarations.name: Repository
declarations.doc: Base of the classes of the `repository` kind. The transpiler writes one call to send per method.

members.name: path
members.doc: Added to the connection's baseUrl (`@repository(path = "characters")`).

members.name: connection
members.doc: `connectionName` of the project config; `''` = the default connection.

members.name: saveLocal
members.doc: `@repository(saveLocal = true)`: the GET methods save what they answer in the local database (the transpiler passes `local:` to send and writes the `<method>AsLocal()` twins).

members.name: local
members.doc: The local table of T (`@repository(saveLocal = true)`, a model with `@primary`): CRUD and queries on the device, as a backend repository.

members.name: send
members.doc: One request. path is joined to the repository's path; `:name` in it takes the value of params or pathParams.

members.name: recall
members.doc: What send with local saved for these arguments, decoded with decode: the rows as they are now in the local table. Throws `NotFound` when that call never answered. The transpiler writes one per local method: `getOneAsLocal(id)`.

members.name: target
members.doc: The url and query of a request: the path with its `:name` values and the params left over (into the query when read).

members.name: attempt
members.doc: Runs request: its value goes through ok and a RepositoryError (an `HttpError`, a `NotFound`) through err. The transpiler uses it for methods that return an `Either` (fpdart): `attempt(() => send(...), Right.new, (e) => Left(MyError(message: e.message)))`.

members.name: purgeCache
members.doc: Removes the cached responses of key (a method's cacheKey, or `Repository.method`).

members.name: buildPath
members.doc: Replaces each `:name` of path with its encoded value; the names used are removed from used.

members.name: toJson
members.doc: Models of json_serializable become maps; maps, lists and primitive values stay as they are.

declarations.name: RepositoryError
declarations.doc: A failure a repository turns into the `Err` of a method that returns `Result<E, T>` (`E(message: error.message)`); in any other method it is thrown. HttpError and the local database's `NotFound` are the two.

declarations.name: Responder
declarations.doc: How a fake connection answers: status code and JSON body.

declarations.name: RouteArgs
declarations.doc: Values of a URL for AppRoute.build.

members.name: arg
members.doc: The path or query parameter name as T (text, int, double or bool; inferred from where it goes).

declarations.name: Rule
declarations.doc: A check of one field: the error message, or null when value is valid. values has every field of the form (for rules that compare fields).

declarations.name: Rules
declarations.doc: The rules of form models, like zod or class-validator. Every message is a translation key (`dragonfly.form.<rule>`) or the text given in `message`. An empty optional field passes every rule except required.

members.name: required
members.doc: Not empty; a boolean must be true (accept the terms).

members.name: number
members.doc: A number (int and double fields have it without writing it).

members.name: matches
members.doc: Equal to the field other (repeat the password).

members.name: asInt
members.doc: The value of a number field: an int, or the text of a text field.

declarations.name: ScreenTransition
declarations.doc: How a screen comes in (`@screen(transition = ScreenTransition.fade)`).

declarations.name: SentRequest
declarations.doc: One request the app sent during a test.

members.name: method
members.doc: `GET`, `POST`...

members.name: path
members.doc: The path without the base URL's host: `/api/character/1`.

declarations.name: Session
declarations.doc: The current session: the data given to SessionManager.start, the token for the backend, the roles and permissions for the ACL, and the values saved with SessionManager.set.

declarations.name: SessionEnded
declarations.doc: The session ended (`SessionManager.destroy`, expiration or a 401 of the backend).

declarations.name: SessionInterceptor
declarations.doc: Adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to each request and ends the session on a 401.

declarations.name: SessionManager
declarations.doc: Creates, keeps and ends the session. It is saved in secure storage (Keychain on iOS and macOS, Keystore-encrypted on Android, libsecret on Linux), ends after timeout without activity, and on destroy clears the response cache and publishes SessionEnded (start publishes SessionS...

members.name: timeout
members.doc: Inactivity that ends the session (null: only `expiresAt`).

members.name: get
members.doc: The data given to start.

members.name: start
members.doc: Starts the session with data (a model, a string...). token goes in the `Authorization` header of each request (with `SessionInterceptor`); roles and permissions are what the ACL checks.

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Ends the session: deletes it from the device, clears the response cache and publishes SessionEnded.

members.name: set
members.doc: Saves a value in the session (JSON: text, numbers, lists, maps); it ends with the session.

members.name: init
members.doc: Restores the session of the previous run, unless it expired.

members.name: touch
members.doc: Activity: restarts the inactivity timer.

declarations.name: SessionStarted
declarations.doc: A session started (`SessionManager.start`); data is what was stored with it.

declarations.name: SplashScreen
declarations.doc: The first screen of the app. It shows child for at least minDuration while onLoad prepares the app (ask the backend, fill the local database) and then goes to next with the router; when onLoad takes longer, it waits for it.

params.name: onError
params.type: ((context: BuildContext, error: Object, retry: VoidCallback) => Widget)?

members.name: next
members.doc: The screen shown after the splash (it needs `@screen(route = ...)`); it replaces the splash, so "back" does not return to it.

members.name: child
members.doc: What the splash shows (a logo, a progress indicator).

members.name: onLoad
members.doc: Runs while the splash is visible.

members.name: onError
members.type: ((context: BuildContext, error: Object, retry: VoidCallback) => Widget)?
members.doc: What to show when onLoad fails; retry runs it again. Without it the error is logged and the app goes to next.

declarations.name: StateManager
declarations.doc: Base of the classes of the `statemanager` kind: a Cubit whose state is a state model.

members.name: emit
members.doc: Emits only while the manager is open (a screen that was closed does not receive late results).

declarations.name: Subscription
declarations.doc: A subscription of Events.subscribe: cancel stops it.

members.name: resume
members.doc: Delivers the event that arrived while the subscriber was not in use, if any.

declarations.name: Translations
declarations.doc: The app's languages. Each locale has one JSON dictionary per component in `assets/i18n/<locale>/` (`characters.json`, `shared.json`...); the file name is the first part of the key: `'characters.home.header.welcomeTitle'.tr()` reads `home.header.welcomeTitle` of `characters.json`.

members.name: bundle
members.doc: Where the bundled dictionaries are read (rootBundle; tests give their own).

members.name: delegates
members.doc: The translations of Flutter's own widgets (date pickers, text selection...).

members.name: locale
members.doc: The current locale (for `MaterialApp(locale: ...)`).

members.name: use
members.doc: Changes the language, remembers it for the next start and rebuilds the app with the new texts.

members.name: tr
members.doc: The text of key in the current locale, then in the fallback; the key itself when it has none. `{name}` is replaced by `args'name'`.

members.name: refresh
members.doc: Downloads the remote dictionaries when the server has a new version; true if they changed.

declarations.name: Validators
declarations.doc: Validators for a plain `TextFormField(validator: ...)`, with the same messages as Rules.

members.name: all
members.doc: The first message of validators.

members.name: thenReturnAsync
members.doc: The mocked async method returns value: `when(() => repo.find(1)).thenReturnAsync(Right(user))`.

declarations.name: compareValues
declarations.doc: Orders JSON values: numbers, texts (ISO dates among them), booleans; null first.

declarations.name: dragonflyRouter
declarations.doc: Builds the go_router of the app from its screens. A screen with `loggedIn` sends to that screen without an active session; one with an ACL rule sends to `denied` when the session does not pass it. It refreshes when the session changes. observers see every navigation (analytics).

declarations.name: inject
declarations.doc: The object registered in the injector for type T.

declarations.name: isErr
declarations.doc: An `Either` that is `Left` (Err).

declarations.name: isErrWith
declarations.doc: A `Left` whose error matches error (a value or a matcher).

declarations.name: isOk
declarations.doc: An `Either` that is `Right` (Ok).

declarations.name: isOkWith
declarations.doc: A `Right` whose value matches value (a value or a matcher).

declarations.name: like
declarations.doc: SQL `LIKE`: `%` any text, `_` one character.

declarations.name: ne
declarations.doc: `ne(null)` is "not null"; a plain `null` in `where` is "is null".
